Results.ReviewText: This was a housewarming gift, and I absolutely love it. Not only is the color amazing but it fits perfectly in my small-ish backyard. I also love that I can find accessories easily, like a side table, which was very important to me. Easy to put together and keep clean. It's simple.
Results.Title: So Good

Results.ReviewText: Excellent looking grill. Has all the capabilities for ur grilling needs. Even heat distribution across the wide cooking area. Love it!
Results.Title: Webber review

Results.ReviewText: The Weber kettle is the best charcoal grill you can buy.  I have owned several over the years.  The quality is always top notch and the new 22” kettle is no exception.  Don’t waste your money on another brand.  Buy a Weber and take care of it.  Parts are always available.  Like with any appliance, parts will wear with use.  With proper care your grill will last at least 5-10 years.  Imagine how many awesome meals you will make!
Results.Title: Buy the best!

Results.ReviewText: Solid construction, easy to assemble.  Thermometer a big help for temperature regulation.  Went back to charcoal from propane, Weber grills have been my go to for charcoal grills.  This grill has not disappointed!
Results.Title: Great charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Love the process, love the results. As a former generic gas grill user, I never knew how much enjoyment I was missing out on, in the name of convenience and saving a few bucks.
Results.Title: Hooked on Weber charcoal

Results.ReviewText: This is my 3rd kettle Weber. Love it. I don't even look at price when it comes to making this purchase. I know what I like & that’s Weber.
Results.Title: Long time user

Results.ReviewText: Well built grill.  Great size for small family.  Love the color, Burnt Orange!  Go Longhorns!
Results.Title: Well built grill

Results.ReviewText: I'm glad I finally bought one of these. It's well built, and truly versatile with a few add-ons.
Results.Title: Very pleased

Results.ReviewText: Comparing the two, the newer one seems to be of thinner metal.  I like the thermometer , the color, the ash catcher, the air system. I don't have proof, but I think the older model ran hotter.
Results.Title: replacement for current 22" weber kettle grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought one of these grills 22 years ago. Used it constantly, moved it several times when I moved. The kettle gave out a few weeks ago, and there was no question it was going to be replaced. The new grill is great- only quibble is no 2nd handle. These grills cook great, are easy to clean and empty, and will last.
Results.Title: Still great after all these years

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble and solidly built and looks good. Holds temperature well once the coals are going, so steaks (direct heat - over coals) and chicken (indirect heat) cook evenly with that real charcoal taste. The hinged grate lets me add more coals without moving the food, and the ash catcher makes cleanup quick. Good size for family dinners. Simple, reliable grill that does everything I need without fuss. We use it twice a week at least in Plano, Texas.
Results.Title: A reliable grill

Results.ReviewText: I've never had a grill as easy to use as my current Weber grill.
Results.Title: Great grilling

Results.ReviewText: Excellent quality and very easy to operate. Quick to cool down.
Results.Title: Very efficient and easy to operate, cools fas.

Results.ReviewText: Good well built kettle, great heat retention. Will be buying another one!
Results.Title: Best around!

Results.ReviewText: The construction of the grill is of high quality. There is plenty of help online to cook about anything. The Weber Kettle is the Jack of all trades when it comes to charcoal grilling. Great experience so far!
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is the second on I have had. The first one lasted 22 years.  Its a great product!
Results.Title: Great Quality Grill

Results.ReviewText: Purchase the rotisserie attachment doesn’t fit securily and grilling rack cannot sit on top of the attachment
Results.Title: Great

Results.ReviewText: I've been using Weber grills for decades, and love them. They're solid and reliable. Recently I needed to buy a new grill, and Weber was clearly the choice! I had no idea they had the green color - looks great, grills great!
Results.Title: Satisfied Weber customer for decades

Results.ReviewText: With Weber i knew what to expect, it did not disappoint. Thank you Weber!
Results.Title: Thank you Weber!

Results.ReviewText: I have owned several Weber 22 Kettles over 30 Years. This grill is very versatile and you can expect years of performance. The Chrome Grill Grate is less than optimal. After time the Chrome flakes and exposes the Steel which will rust. I moved to a 22” Stainless Steel Grill Grate (Amazon) that remains Rust free after 13 Years.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Likes that you can close the lid and reuse the charcoal.
Results.Title: Charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: It works so good and is so easy to light, I bought one for my son and daughter inlaw
Results.Title: Great Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: A very dynamic grill.  The design and available accessories allow you to smoke low and slow or grill hot and fast.  There are a ton of videos on the internet make mastering temperature control a breeze.  The Weber 22-inch kettle is well worth the money.
Results.Title: Great for beginners or seasoned grill masters

Results.ReviewText: Fond memories of Weber kettle from growing up and my Dad always cooking on one. To having several of my own. Weber’s additions have only made using them better. Gold standard for charcoal grills.
Results.Title: Best charcoal grill made.

Results.ReviewText: Everyone in my family has had a kettle for the past 50 years, and it has become a staple in everyone's backyard.
Results.Title: Family Weber

Results.ReviewText: This is a classic it is my first grill and you can’t beat the price and the quality. Made in USA and no frills and gimmicks. Learning curve is easy and food comes out with a better taste.
Results.Title: The only one you need

Photos.Caption: Photos are enclosed but really does not capture how the drum fits together

Results.ReviewText: We bought this grill as a replacement for our old 22 inch Kettle Grill that we had for over 10 years. We loved it so much we bought the exact same one. We bought it the end of May and have used it for a couple months however we noticed that the Kettle part is not sealing properly.  Our old grill did not have this problem. We bought it from Home Depot and had it delivered and I do not know if the kettle part was defective or something could of happened in shipping. I am going to contact the company because for a gill that cost that much it should seal properly.
Results.Title: 22 inch Kettle Premium Grill

Results.ReviewText: My Dad taught me to grill on a Weber kettle in the early ‘70s. That’s all I’ve ever used. I’ve been through two grills since I got my own in ‘88. This new one is exactly what wanted…same quality, same performance. This is the first one with a thermometer in the lid and ash removal mechanism, which is so handy. Funny that after using Weber kettles for so long, the thermometer is for information only. All the same timings work perfectly on the new grill.
Results.Title: Same Quality, Same Performance

Results.ReviewText: Excellent Grill, I have been grilling non-stop every weekend since May 23, 2026. It is easy to clean and the thermometer is very useful with keeping a constant temp and monitoring without opening the grill. I will continue to use it year round.
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: Amazing grill for someone who loves true grilling. It can beat any grill
Results.Title: The best grill

Results.ReviewText: I have had an original Weber Grill for 18 years. I got this upgrade because the old one's bolts broke off and couldn't replace the grill pieces (how convenient). This is a dream grill because the clean up is so much easy and much less messy. Also able to save the new grates because I had just bought new grates before getting this. Its a great grill and love doing ribs and brisket and all kinds of good food on this one.
Results.Title: Loving It

Results.ReviewText: Best charcoal BBQ grill I’ve ever used! I use it to grill everything from steaks, poultry, pork, fish and vegetables
Results.Title: Love using this grill!

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill, but it does not have a way to move the lid staying attached to add food. You have to remove the lid in full and place on the ground which is frustrating. I did not realize this when purchasing the grill, or I would have absolutely ordered another grill.
Results.Title: Good grill, but lid is not attached

Results.ReviewText: for the last half century, we have used nothing but webers and this latest was the fourth. some changes but still the best
Results.Title: best charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Nothing beats the flavor of charcoal grilling. This Weber is solid, sturdy, easy to assemble, and the color is beautiful. We use it at least once a week and absolutely love it. Great quality and worth every penny!
Results.Title: Nothing beats charcoal

14402001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14402001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
